judge_validation_subset.note: Human-graded independently, BEFORE the judge ever saw these, so agreement can be checked before trusting the judge on the full suite. Deliberately restricted to cases where the app actually answers (doesn't refuse) — the judge only ever scores a real answer, so a case the app refuses can't be used to validate it; refusal-correctness is already checked for free by the rule-based check, not the judge. See results/results.md Week 6 section for the reasoning behind each label.
